data.title: Bußgeldbescheid – Speeding fine from Kreis Beispielborken
data.summary: The Kreis Beispielborken – Bußgeldstelle issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against Johanna Beispielacker for driving 23 km/h over the speed limit on 5 October 2026 near Beispielborken. The total amount due is €132.00 and one point is recorded in the Fahreignungsregister; the notice was formally delivered on 24 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for a speeding offense. You may file an objection (Einspruch), in writing or in person at the Bußgeldstelle; the app shows the deadline based on the delivery date shown on the delivery certificate. If you don't object by then, the fine becomes final (rechtskräftig), and the full amount of €132.00 must then be paid within two weeks, as the letter states. A point is also recorded on your driving record. If you want to contest the fine, consider getting advice from a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsrechtsanwalt) before the deadline shown passes.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: Decide whether you want to contest the fine and, if so, submit a written objection or make a declaration in person at the Bußgeldstelle by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you don't object in time, the fine becomes legally final (rechtskräftig) and enforceable.
